subject: cr-info-dy
title: (R)CR.INFO.DY.------INFO.DE.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-21 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) closing Braxton's beatnik-period analysis: 'the beatnik period really only solidified the nature of post-existential source-transfer continuance as an attitude rather than a reality (or as a style rather than life purpose) … this phenomenon would thus define the surface dynamics necessary to establish cross-transfer information progressionalism.' (R)CR-INFO-DY (the reality of creative information dynamics) is crossed with INFO-DE (information descent): the question is what creative-information-dynamics produces in its real instantiation when crossed with information-descent — the descent-vector being the beatnik movement's role as fuel for the next cycle of co-opted style. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) form the upper bridge between subject and partner. STF (source-transfer functionalism) emerges from PROJ-DY and feeds POL-DY (political dynamics) on the right margin. SOC-RT-INT (social reality interior) attaches to POL-DY. INFO-DY (information dynamics) and AFL (affinity alignment) hang below the crossing line. (R)OBS (the reality of observation) feeds upward into (R)CR-INFO-DY from the lower-left. (R)ST (the reality of structure) anchors the lower-center. Structural argument: when creative-information-dynamics is taken as actually obtaining (the (R) prefix), it is constituted by observation and structure as twin lower upstreams, but its productive output collapses into information-descent — the descent being routed through projectional and source-transfer dynamics into political dynamics. The diagram is Braxton's structural diagnostic of how a real creative impulse (the beatniks' initial energy) gets converted by spectacle-diversion into political-dynamic fuel.
